title: Alfonso de Exea, archbishop of Seville to Francesc Climent, 23 Aug 1408, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona (Puig y Puig 1920, app. LXIV)

steps.what: HathiTrust record 100676638 (Puig 1920) tried in curl and the built-in browser: Cloudflare challenge, not solved. archive.org: no copy.
Google Books full-view copy of Puig 1920 found (id CuOlkxWnk-EC, Wisconsin). Book pages and PDF were CAPTCHA-walled, but the in-volume search endpoint and signed page-image URLs answered.

In-volume search for cifra/clave/descifr: p. 466 n. 2 says italics mark the deciphered phrases and Puig rebuilt the key 'a fuerza de paciencia' from lines Climent left on docs. 1063, 461, 463; preface p. 2: 'los diez u once escritos con desconocida clave' deciphered. Appendix index lists 14 'Carta cifrada' items, 1399-1416.
Appendix pages of every cipher item fetched and checked for gaps and for what Puig left unread (page-by-page check by a subagent).

Split under the one-key rule from benedict1399: this letter is from another sender and its key is not shown to be Benedict XIII's (the key was rebuilt on doc. 1068 only), so it gets its own entry with no claim about its key.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): decryption = Puig y Puig 1920 app. LXIV on Google Books (URL); no transcription exists (ciphertext not imaged).

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the only text is a Google Books link that is blocked to scripts; nothing of the letter is in the repository. Relabelled decoded, not read; class already solved kept because the decipherment is in print.
Google Books jscmd=click3 endpoint (signed page-image URLs) answered for Puig 1920 (CuOlkxWnk-EC); PA498-PA507 fetched at 1600 px (research/reading_audit/b26_gbooks_fetch.py), scratchpad only.

Puig's app. LXIV (pp. 500-503) transcribed as printed, italics (his decipherment) marked; footnote numbers left out and his identifications listed in the header; misprints kept (fiuxit, redisivit, parisins, toletamum, cerificari, Aragoniat). English translation made. texts/exea1408_reading.md, _en.md, _reread_log.md.

Reading body scored (b17_score.py, la): 0.376 (76/202) on the classical Latin word list; explicit-hole share 1.0 (202/202). Reader's judgement: the sentences hold throughout. Not checkable against figures: no image of the cipher. Relabelled read (grade A).

texts.label: Exea to Climent, 23 Aug 1408
texts.summary: Alfonso de Exea, archbishop of Seville, to Francesc Climent, Perpignan, 23 Aug 1408, in Benedict XIII's circle during the Schism: the defection of Pedro de Frías, the 'Cardinal of Spain', the order to arrest his revenues in Castile, four candidates for the see of Osma, and the Infante Fernando's expulsion of the prelates and of Leonor López from the court. Entirely in cipher, the longest of these texts (2,339 words as printed); Puig y Puig printed it in 1920 (appendix LXIV, pp. 500-503) with the deciphered passages in italics.

reading_review.note: Puig y Puig's printed decipherment (Pedro de Luna 1920, app. LXIV, pp. 500-503; ACB Çapera no. 133) transcribed from the Google Books page images; italics = his decipherment, the whole letter after the opening formula (2,339 words of the reading body). Explicit-hole share 1.0 (202/202) (classical Latin word list: 0.376 (76/202)); the sentences hold. Not checked against figures: no image of the cipher.
